notes.title: The First Anniversary of Roboom's Release
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

It has finally been a year since Roboom has been released on Steam! It has been a long journey, and Roboom shall continue to thrive and improve each passing year. We once again thank everyone who has been part of this journey. 

To celebrate the First Roboversary, this update brings a few small features:

🚀Additions:

Party Accessories 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/9d7943160fa8005e80d66ee60b32fedbf14463c0.jpg

Equip the brand new party-themed accessories to celebrate anything, whether it's the Roboversary, a birthday, or any kind of special occasion.

Baby Builder 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/afa2d3909aa580db20ccbe5af432270e4bf8f285.gif

Baby Builders are absolute units as they allow you to create lines of turrets to both defend and attack. To allow everyone to acquire this Baby Drone, the maximum number of Baby Drones has been increased from 5 to 6 as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/f0cc82a73a058768f936706a8f8e52759d364682.png
You can even upgrade it using the Quality Peer powerup:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/34ebc0be7892da640bef066b685ea3b7b5a4df9c.png

If you have any feedback about the update or about anything in the game, feel free to share on Roboom's Discord Server. Besides this, many interesting news may come from Robogame Studios in the next weeks!

Until next time, For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Divide & Conquer: New Arena Facilities Have Arrived!
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

It's been a while since Roboom's last update, but the wait is now for worth it! The new features will make the arena and the strategizing feel much more lively and exciting, bringing new challenges & rewards at the end.

🚀Additions:

Enemy Facilities 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/f790d45b112ad59ce5ca9eec1d128b5b37a1adfe.png
Within the Nest of Oblivion, you will now encounter new enemy Facilities. These will first support the enemy against you, healing them, creating bombers and Guardians, and much more. But they come with special rewards, if you can manage to overcome them:
Assimilating Facilities To Your Side 
[previewyoutube=IQN5ZJw4IMQ;full][/previewyoutube]
All you need to do is pick up the Umwertung from a defeated Facility and activate the power-up! The Facility will now be on your side.

Guardians, Viridian Spear & Shield 
Spawning from the Circlons, Guardians guard all enemy Facilities. Assimilating their Facility will make the Facility create Guardians for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/283fab6569143fb7fc080ccb2f98b0f7a6afe651.gif

In addition to this, enemy Guardians may rarely drop a Viridian Spear or a Viridian Shield. These are both very powerful items, and they will each allow you to activate a very powerful power-up...

New Achievement 
What if you assimilate all Facilities in a single run? Then you will acquire a special achievement!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/4565b209fac84ed362b9f12764f9619c69a62c92.png

A Special Weapon... 
Congratulating the winner of the last Roboom Contest, and to fulfill our promise, we have added the brand new Master Uru's Sceptre! Congratulations again Uru!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/4196d0ca5e15be24267bfcece8bd82d310d71288.jpg
New Hats 

3 new hats (Viking Helmet, Korean Samo and Ak Kalpak) have been added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/c0026ea3624c3cc40757baf66154560be12ddf10.png

⤴️Improvements:

New Score Bar 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/c4b48dd994b6f2958bd70d17f8fb5acab46b63c1.jpg
The score bar now has a new design! 

Hope you find the new additions fun! If you have any feedback, you are always more than welcome to share. Feel free to join Roboom's Discord Community.

Until next time, For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Roboom: 2024 Recap
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

After many updates, many adventures and events, we have finally reached the end of 2024. This was an amazing year, which marked the early access release of Roboom, and the game has developed a long way thanks to all of your feedback, thanks to Roboom's wonderful community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/22a35799b5582b20a5d9d56e19d82709b8cc7de1.gif

So, let us take a moment to see how Roboom's journey has been this year:

Leaderboard Timeline
[previewyoutube=m8eGBvwJ1q4;full][/previewyoutube]
Congrats to all players who have been on the leaderboard!

January: Twitch Integration
Note: Robo Designs in January and February are the old demo designs! 

At the beginning of the year, Robocons had neither a face nor any arms, but the war between Visicons and Oblicons was still in full motion. 

[previewyoutube=_W-p1BSwOoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Of course, you may seek fellow helpers in this fight: With the help of the Twitch Integration, you are now able to summon anyone to your help via the Twitch Chat!

February: HUB and Next Fest

Then, in their fight against Oblivion, Visicons needed a place to gather. What could have been better than the Holistic Union Base, the HUB?
[previewyoutube=54GtnvcFkz8;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=De3nROvrjiE;full][/previewyoutube]
Furthermore, the Next Fest this month was truly one of the most important and exciting moments in Roboom's history. Our thanks go once again to countless many players who have dived into the Robocon Universe!

March: New Robos and Roboom Wiki

Then, they evolved:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/fc75f40d930729d44a60dd9712731e7c3a998635.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/7181c28f25f94f458768ca06186f0f1c79cf8f83.gif

With many changes in the game, it was time to create a proper documentation for everything. Roboom thus joined the wiki.gg community, and we have created Roboom's Wiki:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/b04d995f9a1c47ba0540acdde78ccd9a299212b4.png

April: Guns & Glory & Agents of Oblivion

Sure, our Robo has arms. Why not make great use of it?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/45c01883dea57327ac85541487255c880a2f9534.gif

Attention though, you may now encounter Agents of Oblivion!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/267a54d6c435cab6468febfa91138687f845e89b.gif

19 May Release! The 4th Boss Zarakon, Achievements, Weapons-Box, and many more... 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/8dc1903d4db8c591a18dee67b82bfec4348413c9.gif
On May 19, Roboom finally released into Early Access. With this, a new phase in Roboom's journey began. 

June: 🐠Can a fish make you rich?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/b0102e9ee660617851c7903898f21fb09ac9bece.gif

This is a question that we should all think about. Although the answer may seem close to a "no" in the Human Universe, the answer is ａｂｓｏｌｕｔｅｌｙ 𝔂𝓮𝓼 within the Robocon Universe.

August: Your Own Baby Drones

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/fd9d643d5965381ada3b62c59eec7882aa5cf3c7.gif

Before this update, your little fellows, Baby Drones, were just random baby Visicons who came to help you. With this update, they have become much more: From 5 different Visicon classes, now you can adopt them, name them, raise them as you like!

September: Personalize Your Robo!

What's your favorite hat?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/60acef3bb3e4af469729c7606e5b5c19709d96fa.gif

Kaizen: Continuous Improvement

Before the release of co-op, The Kaizen Update was launched to generally improve many aspects of the game, from new enemies to new weapons. Continuous improvement is indeed the very spirit of Roboom, which shall continue in 2025 and beyond.

[previewyoutube=4GtlKf5BsM4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462000/view/4674263407977159088

October: Co-op
Roboom unites people

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/7a39c7fb29f07c9b768e8a2ee26bf69cd400fb4f.gif
This might be the biggest update this year. Because you can now play Roboom with anyone from all over the world or locally! If you haven't yet, co-op is truly one of the most fun and meaningful ways to experience Roboom.

November: Squads

[previewyoutube=7aXszUqSq3k;full][/previewyoutube]

Squads were the logical continuation of having co-op scores: Now you can either join an existing squad or create your own, so that your co-op scores get saved and ranked!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462000/view/4472731215261073567

December: Roboom's First Squad Contest
The First Squad Contest during the Bullet Heaven Fest was amazing, many new players joined Roboom and we saw the creation of first squads:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462000/view/4472733036435211530


What's next for 2025?

Thanks to Roboom's wonderful community, we will march forwards on this journey towards building a game that is both exciting and meaningful. There are many new updates coming, improving and iterating upon already existing features (like the powerups, balance, HUB), bringing the remaining planned bosses and story. 

🌟Roboom is also participating in the official Steam Couch Co-op Fest on 10-17 February, and many updates are coming along the way!

Until next time, For Our Vision, Never Give Up

notes.title: Roboom's First Co-op Contest Launches!
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/7a39c7fb29f07c9b768e8a2ee26bf69cd400fb4f.gif

Roboom's First Co-op Contest launches! Bring your peeps, friends, family and everyone who would play Roboom, create your squad and take your seat in the co-op contest.

Rewards for the Best Teams



All Participants: All participants, regardless of the score and the rank, shall receive a special badge in their profile.

Top 9 Warriors: Receive the even more special golden badge for your participation.

Top 3 Champions: A new permanent upgrade shall be created, with each level containing the names of the members of teams, who have mastered Roboom to become Top 3.

The Supreme Victor: A new power-up or a weapon shall be named after your team and designed based on how you prefer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/b7523a5070b15ce1e0056c53df6ab03afc423a0c.png
Leaderboard is waiting for you!

How to Participate:
The rules are simple. Create a squad, link the robos of your friends on Steam and achieve the highest score you can acquire between the event start and the end date (13.12.2023, 18:00 UTC). You can keep track of your rank from the global leaderboard in the game!

Claiming Your Glory:
Winners will be announced on 14. December on Roboom's Discord Server. Prizes will be distributed following confirmation with the winners to ensure satisfaction, especially for our champion’s personalized weapon.

Note: All participants are subject to the game's fair play policy. Any form of cheating will be detected and result in disqualification.

So, once again the game is set! Together, always remember:

For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2462000/extras/discord.png

notes.title: Bring your peeps together: The Squad Update
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/4b6de4f4605b9bbc808f2f49e9a2c1604ad74cbd.png

You can now create squads and climb up the leaderboard with your peeps! 

Give your squad a name and an emblem you like: All your friends, family, fellow players, and fans can now join your squad to make it even more powerful!

The Total Best of the squad learboard ranks squads based on the total best score of their players.
The Co-op score of the squad learboard ranks squads based on the best co-op score of the squad!

How To Create A Squad
[previewyoutube=7aXszUqSq3k;full][/previewyoutube]
How To Join A Squad
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/003aa77a3e9a4bd24ca33baf7676f96027af1387.png
Simply clicking "Join" on a public squad would be enough. If the squad is private, then you can request to join, and the person who founded the squad can accept it.

Together with Co-op, we believe Roboom now has a solid foundation for the upcoming future. Nonetheless, Roboom will continue to get better with each update. Feel free to create your squad and invite every player you know! Your feedback is more than welcome as always.
 
 For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Co-op is here!
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

The Co-op mode of Roboom is finally here!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/12f306d1736ee58856ffec0e4898a695651da006.gif

Roboom now supports local co-op with up to 4 players! You can enjoy local co-op with your friends even if they don't own Roboom, all that is needed is just a controller. 

Steam Remote Play is also supported! So, you can play together wherever you are 😊

And there is more: Along with many new special powers that you can acquire in co-op runs, if you already own Roboom and have a robo personalized, you can use it when playing co-op!

How To Start Co-op
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/86646a339c6aaac63c7d8a20070424db6cb9cced.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/186408f848b84c005899b3318d2d3f38edfc2e65.png

Immediately to the right of the spawn in the HUB, the Co-op Portal is activated now. You can just connect a controller, and hit start to start your operation!

You can also do many more settings here, from device settings to linking your personalized robos! You can adjust your co-op experience however you like.

New Co-op Weapons and Powerups
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/7a39c7fb29f07c9b768e8a2ee26bf69cd400fb4f.gif
New Weapons and Powerups are available in co-op! Heal your team, resurrect them, and burn together with them enemies - Roboom's co-op mode has many features to support your team's fight against Oblivion.

Co-op is now a fundamental part of Roboom that will get even more enhanced with each update. In this journey, all your suggestions and feedback are welcome.
 
 For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Last Step Before Co-op: The Kaizen Update
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/22a35799b5582b20a5d9d56e19d82709b8cc7de1.gif

In this update, there are many additions and improvements to many areas of Roboom. Let's dive right in!

 Here's a summary of everything new in Roboom (Version 0.4.11):

🚀Additions:

Sentinels & Sentinel Fin 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/1abc13eccd040ce014caee8fbbabb54285e8d04f.gif
Roaming within the walls of Oblivion's Nest, Sentinels will notice you if you stay around the walls for too long -- But if you decide to take them on, they will drop the special item of Sentinel Fins, and its respective powerup will allow you to dash!

New Weapons 
[previewyoutube=4GtlKf5BsM4;full][/previewyoutube]
Temurgen and Oneness of Heart are brand new weapons that you can get from Weapon Boxes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/cca01e3929d717e80775a1e8d02985ca218498f0.png
While Temurgen can deal massive amounts by covering enemies with arrows, Oneness of Heart will boost the damage of your adopted Warrior and Infohunter Baby Drones!

New Items & Powerup Ascensions 

In addition to the Sentinel Fins, you will find other new items dropped by Oblicons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/e1abbd9e71b0e4f36983594b03a0cb484a190b50.png
- Urumday, dropped by Sammlers, protects you against Sammler poison.
- Singularity, dropped by Manipuloid, will create vortices around your Robo Bombs
- Egg of The Smelter, dropped by Agents, will give you a game-changing upgrade for Radiation Field

After picking up the item, all related powerups are optional. And if you want to increase your chances of getting either Singularity or Egg, upgrading the respective powerup will increase your chances a ton!


⤴️Improvements:

Robo Bomb & Radiaton Field 

Robo Bomb and Radiation Field now have cooler upgrade paths! 

Manipuloid Fight 

Manipuloid now have new attacks in his fight! Manipuloid will recover slow amounts of HP when doing his manipulation waves. He may sometimes also summon a Zealoid or create a gravity field to pull you in, which of course he might drop in the form of the Singularity pickup.

Puppet Master 

Puppet Master now does collides with Ghosts only. Acquiring the 2. level of the Roboost will allow you the upgrade this ability, with more damage and creation of puppets from Agents.

🛠️Fixes:
Vision Carrier Roboost now creates the Azuroids correctly
Fixed Baby Educators trying to educate temporary Baby Drones during a run.

The next stop in Roboom's journey is going to be the new Co-op, along with a squad system and an awesome contest! If you have any feedback or suggestions, always feel free to share! 

 For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Time for Your Style: The Individuation Update
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/6192fabd421eed9092457443f4d1ab9d9615159d.gif

As moving forward on Roboom's roadmap, this update brings features that would enable everyone to stylize their Robo and show to the world as they wish!

 Here's a summary of everything new in Roboom (Version 0.4.9):

🚀Additions:

Robo Personalization 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/60acef3bb3e4af469729c7606e5b5c19709d96fa.gif
You can now change the color of your Robo, and you can wear new hats and glasses!

You can now add social links like YouTube and Twitch, and add a custom bio in your leaderboard profiles! Your personalized Robo will also appear here too!



Next up, new gameplay improvements on the way, from powerups to roboosts and much more, as well as foundations for the upcoming co-op!  For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Upcoming Co-op, Roboom's Roadmap & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/c22fcfc83b014d6d7ad6ed0d23e0f706fa8c1531.png
Firstly, this update is a small update fixing various bugs.  What is more important and exciting is Roboom's roadmap for the coming couple of months! Co-op is indeed planned to arrive at the start of November and many features are coming to lay the foundations for the co-op.

Patch Notes for v0.4.8.4

⤴️Improvements: 

 Manipuloid health increased by 50% to a more reasonable level. If Seraphos appears at level 20, he will also have this health.

🛠️Fixes:

 Further performance improvements
 Fixed player drifting on when talking to Visicons in HUB
 Fixed DualSense and DualSchock controllers, as well as Steam Input sometimes not working
 Fixed game soft-locking when pausing during the first Beacon of Qut event
 Fixed a possible bug when pausing game during weapon selection 
 Fixed enemy healthbars remaining on screen when player is defeated
 Fixed Roboomerang exiting out of arena 
 Fixed audio stereo for various sounds in the game 
 Fixed leaderboard screen for Ultrawide and other screen resolutions


If you have any suggestions for co-op or any other features, feel free to share! 

For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Your Next-Generation Companions: The Baby Drone Update
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/fd9d643d5965381ada3b62c59eec7882aa5cf3c7.gif

Continuing on expanding the foundations of Roboom, this update brings color and life to the previous Baby Drone powerup. Baby Drones are now much more than that: You can adopt and raise them in the battle against Oblivion!

 Here's a summary of everything new in Roboom (Version 0.4.8):

🚀Additions:

New Baby Drones 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/91d3ac376a35b7e75f3e6ab72bd815e978df7045.png
Choose a Baby Drone from 5 different Visicon classes! All with different abilities, from healing to slash&dashing and more, assemble a cast of companions who will make you much more powerful against the forces of Oblivion!

You can change the order in which they will appear according to your strategy:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/2e6af493a6dfa013a47d7c358f03e13fbe2c31fd.gif
Baby Drone Adoption and Leveling
To adopt a Baby Drone, you will need an Educator License. Feel free to talk to Minister Alumai for all the information!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/7d6b3fc1eb1b766a36111788af6cb10d4a9de7f2.jpg
Your Baby Drones will gain experience throughout runs, and you can level them up to become stronger once they have enough experience:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/70c794d8d20ee0fffdbedd4a8d088765b97e7b47.png

Baby Drone Achievement 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/af4442f54e452ecad2d0d6cc08a4fd935109a20d.png


⤴️Improvements:

Pre-Release Leaderboard as an Option 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/f103f9410dae6e9bd7184c323b5026007e9dd212.png
Many players have earned incredibly high scores since the change of the score system to an oblitropy-based maximum score from endless-runs, and the leaderboard now displays these scores as the default alltime scores. And of course, the previous scores achieved by players before the changes are visible when the "Show Pre-Release Scores" option is toggled.


New Powerup Icon for Baby Drones 
The description will also show the name of your Baby Drones!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/fa3742840e708f686dc1170500fefc0e69af79e3.png

Baby Drones now follow you faster, remaining within your field of sight.
Players who have adopted Baby Drones will see the powerup much more frequently when they can get it.

🛠️Fixes:

General performance improvements, especially regarding post level 30 enemies.
 Fixed some letters to render better as they should be in the leaderboard.


In addition to all these, many things are on the way, first and foremost Co-op, expansions to many powerups, and the Twitch Extension! 

As again with this update, Robocon Universe is expanding day by day! For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: 🐠Can a fish make you rich?
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!
[previewyoutube=9rX1l0lo8vs;full][/previewyoutube]
Here is Roboom's first content update after the Early Access release! It was a great launch, and we are thankful to every single Roboom player. 

As for the update: We are introducing a new enemy Robocon who is shy, and rarely shows themselves. But there is a special, rare reward for defeating them! Along with this, HUB now has a new area!

 Here's a summary of everything new in Roboom:

🚀Additions:

Nishiki 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/b0102e9ee660617851c7903898f21fb09ac9bece.gif
Now, throughout your runs, you will see Nishiki, who spawn quite rarely! While beautiful, they are shy creatures too, running away immediately after attacking you.
 
Mi Nishiki 
[previewyoutube=8uHihli2a1A;full][/previewyoutube]
If you defeat a Nishiki, you will get the chance to adopt a baby Nishiki, a Mi Nishiki, as your pet fish of fortune!

Mi Nishiki will collect Robonium for you and sometimes will even collect in double, earning you much more Robonium!

⤴️Improvements:

New Warrior Area 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/ae8017d907ea10df74cc6ebfe867e90aa8d2be96.gif
Now, like Otachis and Info-Hunters, Warriors have their own area too! Roboosts have been moved to this area, which will be unveiling more and more of the Warriors! Feel free to boot up and dive into the Warrior Computer! 

Robocon Universe is expanding day by day! Much more is coming to this journey, and remember: For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: It's Finally Here! - Roboom Launches On Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!

After months of development, with your support and feedback, Roboom has now finally been launched on Early Access!

Hope everyone has fun in the Robocon Universe, and as always:
For our Vision, never give up!

notes.title: Roboom Coming to Early Access on 19 May
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!
[previewyoutube=YtSpMNu69Xk;full][/previewyoutube]

We wholeheartedly thank everyone who has participated in Roboom's journey, to every person who has fought for the Holistic Union. After all these months, we have finally reached the next evolution of Roboom with Early Access!

 Here's a summary of everything new in Roboom:

🚀Additions:

New Weapons & Weapons Box Magic 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/9d5db154c9c6c69916a8a8257f46088c47c09dc2.gif
5 New Self-Realization Weapons have been added! These are Ishin, Tinemen Yalquzaq, Seraphos Gun, and Tonton! You can see some of them here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/fef6498fc0da6b24ff7dbd25d1a0ec0473e8e12e.jpg
From shooting lasers to sucking life, all these weapons have special abilities. Try all of them out and see which one is the best!
 
4th Boss
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/8dc1903d4db8c591a18dee67b82bfec4348413c9.gif
Zarakon, The Parasite King a false god of his subordinates, The Parasite King is the 4th boss Warriors will face in the Robocon Universe. He will have many foes preceding him, from laser-beaming arachnids to leeches sucking life, yet he himself is not truly a Robocon, but something from another existence.

Korean Localization 
로보콘 유니버스에서 안녕하세요!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/06f09c6e913d109899797bc7ed6f23a3dac98590.png
Roboom now has got a Korean localization, initially covering most of the fundamentals of the game, soon to expand into the whole game!


⤴️Improvements:

 🎮Roboom Virtual Keyboard & Full Controller Support: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/735dc5d501c0bc2ed4003ddb0dde232c9417b57a.gif
Now Roboom supports full-controller gameplay, whether you are using a Deck, Xbox-Controller, PS-Controller, or any other device, you can now play Roboom without needing a keyboard our mouse! You will see the correct glyphs, and Roboom Virtual Keyboard will help with keyboard input. 


Stay tuned everyone! More is coming to the Robocon Universe, and remember what Visicons say: For Our Vision, Never Give Up!

notes.title: Roboom State of the Game - April 2024
notes.content:
Greetings, all Visicons!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/66757cc829322ee416bf34d8c5fce2af7cb38d6e.gif

As we approach towards the Early Access Release on 19th of May, Roboom is getting stronger! Before the coming 4th Boss for the release version, we have brand new content out that everyone can play in the Demo!

Everything new in Roboom:

Additions:

Guns 4 New Weapons that you can acquire for the arms of your Robo during  a run 💥 These are Raingun, Momentum Rfile, Domdom, and Topatan Rocket Launcher 🙂
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/45c01883dea57327ac85541487255c880a2f9534.gif
Agents🕴️ 🕴️ Under direct control of deep, mysterious forces of Oblivion, Agents are the new Oblicon posing a threat against you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/267a54d6c435cab6468febfa91138687f845e89b.gif
While Agents do leave Robonium when defeated, they have much more conscious tactics, escaping, using guns and healing!

Glory SAN System, the ranking system of the Holistic Union is now introduced! Currently unlockable as you defeat bosses, each promotion to a new rank will be a further key in progressing through the Robocon War and Holistic Union 🙂
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/85127f179b51dcea37ebb35cd5d2b2fe63c4f280.png
Improvements:

 Oblitropy: Oblitropy has been in the game for a long time, but was unaccesible since the HUB Update. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/f9593848d20dde3e1b7c302f32f3ab45b4c0b4bf.png

Upon beating the current version of the game (by harnessing the _Blue Ozstone_), you can now unlock the option to increase Oblitropy level of the Robocon Universe, earning higher scores from a run while making the game more challenging

 PlayStation Controller Glyphs: Now there is an initial support for PlayStation controller glyphs in the HUB. This support will expand to all areas of the game with the full control support coming for both Xbox and PS

 Current Game Completion: Until the new bosses are added, a run will currently be completed at Level 32 and higher Oblitropy levels will be unlocked!

Stay tuned everyone! More is coming to the Robocon Universe, and remember what Visicons say: For Our Vision, Never Give Up

notes.title: Ultimate High-Score Contest of Roboom
notes.content:
Join the Roboom High Score Contest!

Are you ready to mark down your name in the Roboom's history? Dive into our high score competition, climb the leaderboard and show the world your talent!

Rewards for the Best of Robocons
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2462000/extras/roboom-gif1.gif


Top 9 Warriors: Earn an exclusive in-game badge that will forever show your skill to the world. Plus, secure your access to the eagerly awaited "Holistic Union" book upon its release—a must-have for lore aficionados of Roboom.

Top 3 Champions: Receive not one, not two, but three copies of Roboom! Gift them to friends or keep them for any planned future updates.

The Supreme Victor: The top scorer will receive the highest honor. An upcoming in-game character will be created and named after you!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449160/d2cb444e162a4bdb07db1f0c5bf919ef759e18fd.png
How to Participate:
The rules are simple. Achieve the highest score you can acquire between the event start and the end date (20.11.2023, 9:00 PM). You can keep track of your rank from the global leaderboard in the game!

Claiming Your Glory:
Winners will be announced on 21. November on Roboom's Discord Server. Prizes will be distributed following confirmation with the winners to ensure satisfaction, especially for our champion’s personalized character.

Note: All participants are subject to the game's fair play policy. Any form of cheating will be detected and result in disqualification.

So, do you have what it takes to become a legend in Roboom's universe? The battlefield awaits!
